name: open-managed-agents
description: Self-host AI agents with Claude Managed Agents support. Sessions, tools, subagents and recovery on your infrastructure.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:apps && pnpm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:node: pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/sandbox typecheck && pnpm --filter '@open-managed-agents/sandbox-adapter-*' typecheck && pnpm --filter '@open-managed-agents/node-database*' typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/main-node typecheck
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/auth typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/execution-control typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/managed-agents-adapters-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/environment-work-store typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/environment-work-store-memory typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/environment-work-store-sql typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/runtime-resource-contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-runtime-contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-runtime-sql typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-event-store-sql typecheck && pnpm --filter @openma/sdk typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:console
scripts.test:packages: pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/auth test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/execution-control test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/managed-agents-api test:official-worker && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/environment-work-store-memory test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/environment-work-store-sql test && pnpm --filter @openma/sdk test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-runtime test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-runtime-sql test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/session-event-store-sql test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/sandbox test && pnpm --filter '@open-managed-agents/sandbox-adapter-*' test && pnpm --filter '@open-managed-agents/node-database-*' test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/main-node test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/managed-agents-adapters-sql test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/managed-agents-adapters-blob test && pnpm --filter @open-managed-agents/managed-agents-adapters-runtime test
